title: New Short(est) Single Axioms for Classical Logic: search code and proof archive
description: Search code, exact equational lower-bound results, reproducibility tools, and machine-checkable Prover9 certificates accompanying the paper New Short(est) Single Axioms for Classical Logic. The archive includes the official LADR-2009-11A Prover9 and Vampire 5.0.1 source releases together with the reference executables used for the archived computations. Licensing varies by component and is documented in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
